name: Blackmagic ATEM
author: Control It Team
subtitle: Broadcast Video Switcher Control
descriptionText: Control Cut, Auto transitions, program bus, preview bus, downstream keyers, and macros on ATEM mini, Television Studio, and Constellation switchers via direct UDP persistent connection with real-time tally.

setupFields.label: ATEM Switcher IP
setupFields.helpText: Enter the IP address of your ATEM Switcher on the local network.

setupFields.label: Port
setupFields.helpText: Default ATEM UDP control port is 9910.

setupFields.label: Connection Timeout (seconds)
setupFields.helpText: Seconds to wait for full ATEM state synchronization before timing out.

setupFields.label: Mix Effects Bus (M/E)
setupFields.helpText: Select the target M/E bus (M/E 1 for ATEM Mini and single-bus switchers).

variables.name: In Transition
variables.descriptionText: Whether an auto transition is in progress

actions.title: ATEM: Cut Transition
actions.subtitle: Instant switch program to preview
actions.descriptionText: Performs an instant hard cut transition between program and preview buses on M/E 1.

actions.title: ATEM: Auto Transition
actions.subtitle: Smooth dissolve transition
actions.descriptionText: Triggers the current Auto transition (Mix, Dip, Wipe, or DVE) on M/E 1.

actions.title: ATEM: Set Program Input
actions.subtitle: Set live on-air camera/source
actions.descriptionText: Directly assigns an input (Cam 1-8, Color Bars, Media Player) to the Program bus.

actions.title: ATEM: Set Preview Input
actions.subtitle: Cue next camera/source
actions.descriptionText: Assigns an input to the Preview bus for monitoring before going live.

actions.title: ATEM: Fade to Black (FTB)
actions.subtitle: Fade all outputs to black
actions.descriptionText: Fades program video and master audio to black.

actions.title: ATEM: Run Macro
actions.subtitle: Execute saved hardware macro
actions.descriptionText: Triggers a pre-recorded macro sequence stored on the ATEM switcher hardware.

actions.title: ATEM: Get Program Input
actions.subtitle: Query active on-air camera
actions.descriptionText: Queries current live Program bus input with real-time tally color and title feedback.

actions.title: ATEM: Get Preview Input
actions.subtitle: Query cued preview camera
actions.descriptionText: Queries current Preview bus input with real-time preview tally color and title feedback.

actions.title: ATEM: Get Input Tally
actions.subtitle: Tally indicator for input
actions.descriptionText: Checks live tally status for a specific input channel (Red on Program, Green on Preview).

actions.title: ATEM: Get Transition Status
actions.subtitle: Check in-transition state
actions.descriptionText: Queries whether an auto transition is currently active on M/E 1.

actions.title: ATEM: Get Fade to Black Status
actions.subtitle: Check FTB active state
actions.descriptionText: Queries whether Fade to Black is currently active on the switcher.

actions.title: ATEM: Get Switcher Status
actions.subtitle: Connected switcher model & info
actions.descriptionText: Queries switcher model name, connection state, and bus overview.
